description: A shell script for verifying e2e test ownership policies in Kubernetes, including dependency setup, policy evaluation, and reporting.

methods.name: ensure_dependencies
methods.description: Rebuilds dependencies if necessary, including ginkgo, e2e.test, and spec summaries.

methods.name: generate_results_json
methods.description: Generates a JSON report of test ownership policies based on spec summaries.

methods.name: generate_summary_json
methods.description: Creates a summary JSON of policy pass/fail results.

methods.name: generate_failures_json
methods.description: Filters and reports tests that failed policy checks.

methods.name: output_results_and_exit_if_failed
methods.description: Outputs results, checks for failures, and exits with status 1 if any test fails.
